statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-119378 is a use after free in SQLite's R-Tree extension: a database that declares the %_node shadow table WITHOUT ROWID, or gives it a RAISE(IGNORE) trigger, makes nodeWrite() record new nodes as 0, and the process uses freed memory after node splits. SQLite lists it as fixed in 3.54.0: https://sqlite.org/cves.html, https://sqlite.org/src/info/6a9e1415659f9e75. The trunk fix is that check-in, mirrored as https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite/commit/d21bd37c7cfc1b85b17a6703555f0926b6236e04, and the same change on the 3.53 maintenance branch is https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite/commit/63b6d705252209bb52252c314ce6a0a6d67e0db7, which makes nodeWrite() in ext/rtree/rtree.c return SQLITE_CORRUPT_VTAB when sqlite3_last_insert_rowid() returns 0 instead of adding the node to its hash table, and adds a regression test to rtreeI.test. DHI's 3.53.4-r1 build is SQLite 3.53.4 with a backport of the branch commit. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository publishes packages built from source sqlite (sqlite, sqlite-libs, sqlite-static, sqlite-dev and sqlite-doc) at 3.51.1-r0, 3.51.2-r0, 3.53.4-r0 and 3.53.4-r1, for x86_64 and aarch64. We unpacked the sqlite, sqlite-libs, sqlite-static and sqlite-dev packages of every one of those builds on both architectures, each checked against its index checksum. SQLite is compiled into three files in each build: the sqlite3 shell in the sqlite package, which carries its own copy and does not link libsqlite3; the shared library in sqlite-libs; and the static archive libsqlite3.a in sqlite-static. sqlite-dev holds only headers, a pkg-config file and the libsqlite3.so link. The shell and both libraries report SQLite 3.51.1, 3.51.2, 3.53.4 and 3.53.4 in those builds. The 3.51.1-r0, 3.51.2-r0 and 3.53.4-r0 builds are built from the upstream 3.51.1, 3.51.2 and 3.53.4 releases, none of which contains the fix. The R-Tree extension is compiled in: the compile-option list in the shell and both libraries of every build includes ENABLE_RTREE. We ran that regression test's case (an R-Tree table of 51 rows whose t1_node shadow table has a BEFORE INSERT trigger that calls RAISE(IGNORE), reopened, then INSERT INTO t1 VALUES(1000, 0, 1, 0, 1)) with the sqlite3 shell (defensive mode off) and with a test program linked once against the shared library and once against the static archive, for every build on x86_64 and aarch64. The insert succeeds in 3.51.1-r0, 3.51.2-r0 and 3.53.4-r0 and fails with "database disk image is malformed" in 3.53.4-r1, which is the result the fix's test expects, on both architectures and in all three copies. The x86_64 runs used Docker Desktop's amd64 emulation. So 3.51.1-r0, 3.51.2-r0 and 3.53.4-r0 are affected and 3.53.4-r1 is fixed.
